浏览器走 QUIC/ECH，握手内容里看不出目标域名；启动器的 Qt 只有 TC: Browsers use QUIC/ECH, so the target host is hidden inside the handshake; the launcher's Qt only has TCP and sends SNI in plain text. That is why "the site opens but the program cannot".

这条线路阻断的是数据域名的 TLS 握手（SNI），www.ctmmaps.co: This route blocks the TLS handshake (SNI) of the data domain; www.ctmmaps.com itself opens, which is why "the site works but the list never loads". Browsers bypass it with HTTP/3 (QUIC + ECH); Qt has no HTTP/3, so the browser channel or a proxy is the way out.

MC 默认是 Ctrl 奔跑、Shift 蹲下，这一项直接对调。\n1.12 及:

Turns clouds off. 1.8 and later write renderClouds; 1.7 and earlier write clouds.
Since 1.19 the game itself writes a quoted "false"; this follows the file's existing dialect.
Cosmetic / performance only, never touches the save.
关掉 autoJump（1.8 起才有这个键，更早的版本自动跳过）。\n自动跳远:
Turns autoJump off (the key exists since 1.8; earlier versions skip it).
Auto jump jumps for you at block edges — it often gets in the way in parkour, pressure-plate
and precision-landing maps.
写 renderDistance:12。\n老版本上限 16、新版本 32，超出:
Writes renderDistance:12.
Old versions cap at 16, new ones at 32, and out-of-range values are ignored, so it is clamped to 2–32.
Big maps plus long view distance eat memory; 12 is the compromise between looks and frame rate.
